description: South African phone number formatting and classification: converts an SA number in any common format to international +27 (E.164) and local formats, and says whether it is mobile, landline (with area for major cities), toll-free, VoIP or premium-rate. Useful for cleaning contact lists, SMS and WhatsApp messaging, and form validation. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

number.description: Phone number in any common format, e.g. 082 123 4567 or +27 11 555 1234
